profile.headline: Software Engineer at Amazon Leo Security

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Boys and Girls Clubs of America
volunteerExperiences.description: As a member of a club called Keystone, a sub-group of the Boys and Girls Clubs of King County, I participated in and helped come up with and direct many different events to raise money for those less fortunate, help watch over large groups of kids while raising money at overnight events, and clean up our city. We traveled to places like Atlanta, GA for community service gatherings and even hosted festivals featuring artists such as Macklemore and the Blue Scholars.
